  <div class="ws-instruction">
    Fill this pack before the pilot starts, then sign and date it once on this sheet; that date is your before-picture. Panel A is the metric baseline register, one row per metric, split across two sheets. Name an owner on every row before the data is pulled. Enter the number you measured today in &ldquo;Ours, measured&rdquo;, or write <b>not measurable today</b> with an owner and a date. Read &ldquo;What it does NOT tell you&rdquo; aloud for every row. Write the method so someone who was not in the room can re-run it unchanged. Set your 6- and 12-month targets against your own measured number, never against the book's prior or the chapter's illustration. Leave every blank prior cell blank. Panel B then picks one instrumentation level, Panel C records where engineering hours go, and Panel D records the first initiative before it starts.
  </div>
